messages:
Sophie_CS: MarinaTech just opened a formal request to onboard a custom multilingual reranker (EN/ES/FR) to replace their current spine. They listed: on-prem HSM for key material, PHI & PCI-aware redaction, mobile p95 <= 100ms, canary rollout to 10% first wave. They called out renewal risk if not in prod by end of month. Can we triage?
Evan_PM: Copy. Do we have data profile + qps? 100ms p95 for mobile reranker is aggressive; might need model size tradeoffs or infra in-region.
Sophie_CS: MarinaTech provided rough numbers: ~15M docs, peak qps ~120 globally, expected steady qps ~40, canary 10% traffic. They prefer 7B if quality OK. Security lead emphasized HSM + audit logs + token retention policy.
Liam_Infra: For p95 100ms we should assume Dedicated GPUs colocated with their region and tune batchers. Mobile clients -> keep batching shallow/disabled, rely on KV/prefix caching. HSM requirement forces Private deployment + KMS/HSM integration; expect 10–14d onboarding for cert exchange / network peering.
Nora_Safety: PHI requirements: we'll need a labeled sample (2k examples ideal) and explicit acceptance criteria. I'll own the safety evals but need an adversarial prompt bank and continuous monitoring hooks. Also need token retention & redaction audit trail clarified.
Sophie_CS: I'll request the 2k labeled PHI examples and ask MarinaTech to state pass/fail thresholds. Also asking for their compliance contacts.
Liam_Infra: Suggest a two-track plan to accelerate: 1) short track — spin up quantized 7B (INT8/QLoRA) on Dedicated private overlay and run evals; 2) fallback — hosted 13B variant if quality delta unacceptable. That lets us start perf tuning while HSM certs are in flight.
Evan_PM: High-level timeline if we kick Monday: HSM/network + certs ~10–14d; model eval/tuning ~7d; canary + monitoring ~3d. EOM is tight; depends on MarinaTech turnaround on labeled data and signing Dedicated reservation.
DeployBot: Canary template instantiated at /deployments/canary-templates/multilang-reranker. Assigned owners: @Liam_Infra (infra), @Nora_Safety (safety gate).
Nora_Safety: Proposed safety gates: redaction recall >= 0.98, false-redact <= 0.02, semantic-fidelity check using embedding similarity on 300 held pairs, plus adversarial prompt suite. We'll block canary if recall < threshold.
Liam_Infra: Cost note for AE: Dedicated reserved capacity is likely required to meet latency SLOs. Private/HSM integration is billable professional services-ish work; I'll provide a committed+burst pricing breakdown.
Evan_PM: Renewal risk mitigation: offer an interim hosted path with customer-side PHI preprocessor as a temporary workaround; call out tradeoffs for security/compliance.
Sophie_CS: Action items: Sophie 1 collect labeled PHI sample & security contact; Liam 1 scope infra & cost estimate + perf plan; Nora 1 draft safety eval plan + adversarial set; Evan 1 draft renewal-risk mitigation note for AE. I'll schedule a kickoff with MarinaTech tomorrow and prepare a one-pager for their security team.
Sophie_CS: MarinaTech security lead (cc'd) asked for a short one-pager outlining HSM onboarding steps, audit log format, and retention policy. I'll post the draft here when ready.
Liam_Infra: Quick runbook pointer I shared in DM: intra.redwood/runbooks/hsm-onboarding — top steps: 1) network peering/VPN 2) HSM cert exchange 3) KMS key policy + IAM 4) smoke perf baseline + security audit.
Nora_Safety: Also flag: need monitoring hooks for false-negatives in redaction and alerting to on-call SRE. We'll integrate safetyrules into the canary pipeline.
Evan_PM: If MarinaTech can't supply labeled PHI fast enough, propose a paid data-labeling sprint (2–3d) as an option to keep timeline.
Sophie_CS: Thanks team. I'll update after kickoff. :thumbsup:
